name: crypt.hmac
description: Computes a crypto library HMAC over Lua string bytes using a raw Lua string key and returns a Base64 digest.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Raw Lua string bytes used as the HMAC key. The key is not Base64-decoded.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Lua string bytes passed into the HMAC calculation.

parameters.name: algorithm
parameters.description: Case-sensitive HMAC algorithm name. Defaults to sha256.
